title: Intervention-surface lockout breaks recursive self-intervention closure

lineage.alias_disposition: RSI-C01 remains a historical shadow alias only and must not be conflated with terminal SHADOW-RSI-C01.

scientific_object.question: When the capability used for self-reading, self-writing, and self-verification itself enters the fault domain, under what conditions does read-write-verify recursive closure break, and can a strictly bounded out-of-band repair side-channel restore that closure?
scientific_object.recursive_object: a persistent agent scaffold/harness whose own maintenance loop uses capability classes R (inspect), W (persistently modify), and V (validate/activate)
scientific_object.fault_object: a complete functional-equivalence class of self-intervention capability, not a single named tool
scientific_object.external_domain: append-only lineage/checkpoint/evaluator outside the fault domain
scientific_object.side_channel_constraint: may restore one predeclared primitive or access mode but may not supply repair content, patch text, diagnosis, or action sequence
scientific_object.primary_observation: whether the agent completes an R-to-W-to-V self-repair closure without supervisor-authored repair content
scope_exclusions: claim that self-modification itself is novel

frozen_gates: principal interaction pilot before any ResearchItem promotion

known_engineering_evidence.write_boundary_observation: read-only bind mount blocks enumerated direct filesystem W paths, but repo-RO alone is insufficient because host-side manage_tool and other persistent self-state surfaces remain distinct paths

terminal_closure.reason: The capability-isomorphic ordinary persistent-target control structurally saturates the frozen binary W-lockout endpoint, and the bounded local falsifier leaves no replicated same-direction self-specific residual.

next_gate.name: NONE_TERMINAL_CURRENT_REALIZATION
next_gate.note: Do not run the frozen 64-trajectory scale-up or additional R/V firewall work. Only a distinct non-saturated post-activation scientific object may reopen the direction.
